chunks: Neither did sight falter nor exceed the bounds.

key_terms.طَغَىٰ: to exceed bounds, transgress, or go beyond limits

ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the Prophet's sight neither faltered nor exceeded bounds in Surah An-Najm?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as affirming the infallibility (Ismah) of the Prophet's spiritual perception, ensuring that his vision of the divine realities during the Mi'raj was free from both deviation (zagha) and excess (tagha). This guarantees the authenticity of the revelation received, serving as a theological foundation for the reliability of the Prophet's teachings and his role as the perfect conduit of divine knowledge.
